top_comments.author: ollie-anthropic
top_comments.body: Hey, looks like this is an upstream problem via cloudflare's bot protection mechanisms. We have stricter policies for the OAuth endpoint. If you really need, you can use your API key for auth here, or try and change the country / vpn source.
